boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's ctrdg_common.c, 0x0206a318..0x0206a600: 7 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. pret/pokediamond's arm9/lib/NitroSDK/src/CTRDG_common.c defines, in source order, CTRDGi_InitCommon, the CTRDG_IsAgbCartridge/IsOptionCartridge/GetAgb* family, CTRDG_IsPulledOut, CTRDG_IsExisting, CTRDGi_ChangeLatestAccessCycle, CTRDGi_RestoreAccessCycle, CTRDGi_LockByProcessor, CTRDGi_UnlockByProcessor, CTRDGi_SendtoPxi, then the copy/read/enable routines. Seven of them are here, each identified by body: CTRDGi_SendtoPxi 0x64, UnlockByProcessor 0x28, LockByProcessor 0x80, RestoreAccessCycle 0x34, ChangeLatestAccessCycle 0x48 and InitCommon 0x40 at pret's sizes, and CTRDG_IsExisting at 0x120 (0x11c in pret).

Order: all seven are C, and mwccarm emits deferred C bodies in reverse. The ROM run is exactly pret's source order reversed (SendtoPxi lowest, InitCommon highest), with the functions nothing in this game calls dropped by the linker.

BOTTOM EDGE: changeScanChannel (0x0206a29c..0x0206a318), the highest-addressed function of mb_wm_base.c (arm9/MB_WmBase) and the first in its source, steps the wireless scan channel through WM_GetAllowedChannel's mask; it is not cartridge code.

TOP EDGE: 0x0206a600..0x0206a928 is the Nitro SDK's ctrdg_proc.c (arm9/CTRDG_Proc), which pret's pokediamond has as CTRDG_proc.s: the pulled-out PXI callbacks, CTRDGi_CallbackForInitModuleInfo, the module-info setup and CTRDG_Init, a different file.
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/MI_Memory and arm9/OS_SpinLock: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.
Every symbol was renamed from its func_ name to the SDK name in this change (symbols/actor_renames.tsv records the evidence).
Text-only: CTRDGi_Work (0x020a9de0) stays an extern. The file claims no data.
The lock-info and access-cycle records stay int arrays: every caller declares them that way.
